{"id":2008132323,"question_id":2766,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months","timestamp":1779279277,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2008132323/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Prefix Common Array of Two Arrays","memory":"88.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> findThePrefixCommonArray(vector<int>& A, vector<int>& B) {\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n\n        int count = 0;\n        vector<int>ans;\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<A.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            mp[A[i]]++;\n            mp[B[i]]++;\n            \n            if(mp[A[i]] == 2) count++;\n            if(mp[B[i]] == 2) count++;\n            if(A[i] == B[i]) count--;\n            ans.push_back(count);\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-prefix-common-array-of-two-arrays","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2018}
